content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to working with [company_name] [product_name] controller. This is my first project using this device. I am transferring the program to the [article_no] module with an SD card, but the controller does not run the program stored on the SD. My computer can see the program file, yet the controller displays an empty program. How can I get the controller to read the LOGO_U_P.bin file? In the information window of [product_name] Soft Comfort, there is a message: 0 Message blocks lines transferred.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Diagnosing this remotely can be challenging. Is your SD card formatted as FAT32? Did you perform a full (“slow”) format instead of a quick format? Is the capacity of your card under 32 GB? Could you upload your program as a zip file for review? Which exact [product_name] model do you have? Please specify the firmware version.

Hi [user_name], thank you for your assistance. My issue was due to choosing [article_no] standard in the hardware settings, when it needed to be [article_no] FS4. Selecting the correct configuration has resolved the problem.
Glad to hear that it’s working now. That’s what matters most.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a problem where their [company_name] [product_name] controller equipped with a [article_no] module was unable to execute a program transferred via SD card, with the controller displaying only an empty program despite the file being present on the SD card. The root cause was an incorrect hardware setting in the configuration software, where the wrong module version was selected, preventing proper identification and execution of the program. After basic troubleshooting, the user identified and corrected the configuration, resolving the issue quickly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that transferring a program from an SD card to the controller should be straightforward, with the program executing correctly without requiring extensive troubleshooting.
